title: Industrial Conveyor Tolls
description: You are managing a specialized conveyor belt system in a factory. The system consists of multiple checkpoints numbered from 0 to N-1. At each checkpoint i, you must pay a specific toll fee given by an array 'tolls' to pass through it, and then you can jump either 1 or 2 checkpoints forward. You can start your journey at either checkpoint 0 or checkpoint 1. Determine the minimum total cost to reach the end of the conveyor system beyond the last checkpoint.
input_format: An array of integers 'tolls' representing the cost at each checkpoint.
output_format: An integer representing the minimum cost to clear the system.

examples.explanation: Start at index 1, pay 15, and you are past the end.
Pay tolls at optimal steps to minimize total cost.
